record: Co-led with Rep. Gottheimer the Stop Rogue AI Act, directing NIST to set standards for discovering, verifying, monitoring and controlling AI agents, including letting people revoke an agent's access at any time.
With Rep. Gottheimer, sent a letter to the CEOs of OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Meta, Perplexity and X Corp. on political bias and misinformation in AI ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
grade_reason: He spoke about AI several times in 2026 (AI agent standards, elections, workforce, chatbots and children) but no statement found acknowledges catastrophic risk. He explicitly opposed a pause and a slowdown on 17 September 2026, which is D under ruling 6, not F, since he did not dismiss catastrophic risk itself.
